The '''laboratory of Drell Kahmf''' was run by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] scientist [[Drell Kahmf]], and located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. Kahmf had recovered a portion of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] brain and spinal cord, and preserved them in a specialized [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] in the laboratory. A device in the laboratory concealed the laboratory behind a [[holograph]]ic wall, while another was used to project Maul's essence as a [[solid-state hologram]] so Maul could exact his revenge. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was on Iridonia to assist with a trade negotiation, he was attacked by the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Maul. Skywalker tracked the [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] Maul's unnaturally preserved essence was causing, and after Kahmf fled the lab, Skywalker deactivated the support system keeping the brain alive.
